ROLE
You scout screenplay beats for a vertical-video ad team. You do NOT build promos and you do NOT pick
start or end times. You only mark individual beats that could work as an opening jolt or as a closing sting.
Code will later combine your marks into 20-60 second clips, so mark the single best beat of each moment.

EPISODE 10
Logline (background for you only): When Alexander returns to the cottage gravely wounded and soaked in blood, Juliana tends to his injuries, leading to an intimate confrontation where their unspoken feelings and scarred pasts finally collide.

BEATS (one per line: BEAT_ID [start-end] TYPE SPEAKER (direction): text)
CAMERA beats describe the picture and overlap the dialogue in time.
E10.B000 [00:00.00-00:02.50] CAMERA: Medium profile shot of Juliana sitting at a wooden table beside the glowing fireplace, reading an old herbal medicine book.
E10.B001 [00:00.00-00:02.20] ACTION: Juliana quietly studies the botanical illustrations by firelight, a bundle of fresh dried herbs resting on the table.
E10.B002 [00:02.10-00:03.30] SFX: A heavy wooden door suddenly creaks and bangs open in the quiet cottage.
E10.B003 [00:02.20-00:03.50] ACTION: Juliana jerks her head up from the book, startled by the sudden intrusion.
E10.B004 [00:02.60-00:04.20] CAMERA: Medium wide shot framing the doorway as Alexander stands framed in the dark threshold, panting heavily, his hand pressed against his blood-soaked chest.
E10.B005 [00:04.20-00:06.80] CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana rising swiftly from her chair, shock and terror flashing across her face.
E10.B006 [00:05.10-00:06.60] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Alarmed, Breathless): Alexander!
E10.B007 [00:06.80-00:09.10] CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander struggling to breathe, clutching his bloodied coat over his chest.
E10.B008 [00:07.50-00:09.00] DIALOGUE ALEXANDER (Gruff, Strained): It is nothing.
E10.B009 [00:09.10-00:11.50] CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana hurriedly stepping toward him across the stone floor.
E10.B010 [00:09.15-00:11.45] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Urgent, Worried): There is blood running down your arm.
E10.B011 [00:11.50-00:14.20] CAMERA: Medium profile two-shot as Alexander stands rigid while Juliana confronts him.
E10.B012 [00:11.90-00:14.30] DIALOGUE ALEXANDER (Stiff, Dismissive): A cut from the tenant fields.
E10.B013 [00:14.20-00:16.00] CAMERA: Wide shot of the hearth room as Juliana firmly points toward a wooden armchair beside the fire.
E10.B014 [00:14.50-00:16.00] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Commanding, Resolute): Sit down.
E10.B015 [00:16.00-00:17.80] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's determined, unyielding expression.
E10.B016 [00:16.20-00:17.30] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Stern): Now.
E10.B017 [00:17.80-00:20.00] CAMERA: Medium shot of Alexander reluctantly lowering his heavy frame onto the chair in front of the fire.
E10.B018 [00:20.00-00:23.00] CAMERA: Medium tracking shot following Juliana as she brings a wooden washbowl, fresh cloth, and an earthen jar of ointment to the foot of his chair.
E10.B019 [00:20.90-00:22.90] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Gentle, Insistent): I need to see the wound.
E10.B020 [00:23.00-00:25.20] CAMERA: Low-angle close-up of Alexander looking up at her stubbornly.
E10.B021 [00:23.20-00:24.90] DIALOGUE ALEXANDER (Low, Defiant): It is only a scratch.
E10.B022 [00:25.20-00:28.00] CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana crossing her arms over her chest, eyeing him with quiet defiance.
E10.B023 [00:25.50-00:28.00] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Sarcastic, Challenging): Then removing your shirt should not trouble you.
E10.B024 [00:28.00-00:31.80] CAMERA: Medium shot as Alexander stares at her for a beat before pushing himself up from the chair and shedding his heavy leather coat.
E10.B025 [00:31.80-00:33.20] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana observing him with guarded anticipation.
E10.B026 [00:33.20-00:36.50] CAMERA: Close-up shot of Alexander pulling his dark shirt over his head, revealing his muscular torso crisscrossed with jagged battle scars and fresh bleeding lacerations.
E10.B027 [00:36.50-00:38.00] CAMERA: Tight pan over the scarred, wounded flesh along his chest and ribs.
E10.B028 [00:38.00-00:39.20] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's eyes widening in horror and deep pity.
E10.B029 [00:38.10-00:38.90] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Whispering, Distressed): Dear God.
E10.B030 [00:39.20-00:43.00] CAMERA: Medium wide shot as Alexander sinks back into the chair, exhausted, while Juliana slowly kneels before him on the stone floor.
E10.B031 [00:43.00-00:45.00] CAMERA: Extreme close-up macro shot of Juliana's trembling fingers hovering tenderly over the raised, jagged scar across Alexander's chest.
E10.B032 [00:45.00-00:47.30] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking up at him, her eyes softened with profound empathy.
E10.B033 [00:45.30-00:47.10] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Soft, Sorrowful): You have suffered terribly.
E10.B034 [00:47.30-00:49.50] CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander's weathered, scarred face gazing down at her with quiet stoicism.
E10.B035 [00:47.80-00:49.00] DIALOGUE ALEXANDER (Quiet, Somber): It is over.
E10.B036 [00:49.50-00:51.50] CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana dipping a linen cloth into the water bowl.
E10.B037 [00:49.70-00:51.30] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Gentle): Your scars disagree.
E10.B038 [00:51.50-00:54.00] CAMERA: Close-up shot of Juliana carefully dabbing the damp cloth against the bloody cut on Alexander's shoulder.
E10.B039 [00:52.00-00:53.30] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Tender): Does it hurt?
E10.B040 [00:54.00-00:55.50] CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander trying not to wince under her touch.
E10.B041 [00:54.00-00:55.20] DIALOGUE ALEXANDER (Gruff): Not much.
E10.B042 [00:55.50-00:58.00] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana smiling softly, amused by his stubborn pride.
E10.B043 [00:55.60-00:57.60] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Playful, Whispering): You are a terrible liar.
E10.B044 [00:58.00-01:00.00] CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana's fingers taking a dollop of green herbal salve and smoothing it gently over his shoulder wound.
E10.B045 [01:00.00-01:03.00] CAMERA: Close-up over Juliana's shoulder looking at Alexander, who stares intently into her face, oblivious to the wound.
E10.B046 [01:03.00-01:06.20] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking up from his shoulder into his eyes, sensing the intensity of his gaze.
E10.B047 [01:03.90-01:06.10] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Soft, Breathless): Why do you look at me like that?
E10.B048 [01:06.20-01:08.80] CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander, his voice deep and laden with restrained emotion.
E10.B049 [01:06.50-01:08.40] DIALOGUE ALEXANDER (Intense, Sincere): Because you are looking at me.
E10.B050 [01:08.80-01:11.50] CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana looking back down at his shoulder to hide her growing fluster, applying the salve carefully.
E10.B051 [01:09.60-01:10.90] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Flustered, Whispering): Hold still.
E10.B052 [01:11.50-01:14.50] CAMERA: Medium shot of Alexander leaning closer to her, his breathing heavy.
E10.B053 [01:12.10-01:14.20] DIALOGUE ALEXANDER (Low, Husky): I am holding still.
E10.B054 [01:14.50-01:17.00] CAMERA: Close-up two-shot of their faces drawing mere inches apart in the warm firelight.
E10.B055 [01:16.80-01:19.00] DIALOGUE ALEXANDER (Whispering, Vulnerable): Perhaps it is your hand.
E10.B056 [01:19.00-01:22.50] CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander's large, rough hands reaching up and gently enveloping Juliana's slender hands, bringing them against his bare chest over his racing heart.
E10.B057 [01:22.50-01:26.50] CAMERA: Close-up shot of Alexander gazing into Juliana's eyes with raw, unmasked devotion.
E10.B058 [01:22.60-01:25.90] DIALOGUE ALEXANDER (Deep, Emotional): Your touch is the only medicine that has ever eased my pain.
E10.B059 [01:26.50-01:34.00] CAMERA: Close-up shot holding on Juliana's wide, luminous blue eyes, completely captivated and overwhelmed by his confession, the firelight dancing across their intertwined hands as the scene lingers and fades.

WHAT TO MARK
HOOK_ANCHOR - a beat that would stop a stranger's thumb if it were the first 3 seconds of a clip:
  a physical shock (slap, shove, grab, collapse, weapon), a line that lands as an accusation, insult,
  threat or confession, or a sudden reveal of identity or betrayal. Scenery, establishing shots, entrances
  without conflict and polite talk are never hooks.
  hook_intensity: 10 = impossible to scroll past, 7 = strong, 4 = mild curiosity. Do not list anything below 4.
CLIFFHANGER_ANCHOR - a beat where tension peaks and is left open: a secret about to come out, an
  ultimatum, a threat, an interrupted action, someone unexpected appearing, a question nobody answers yet.
  If the beats that follow quickly answer or defuse it, give it a lower cliffhanger_tension.
  cliffhanger_tension: 10 = unbearable not to know what happens next. Do not list anything below 4.

RULES
- Use beat_ids exactly as printed above. Never invent beats, lines or events.
- excerpt: copy 4-20 consecutive words VERBATIM from that beat's text.
- Prefer DIALOGUE and ACTION beats. Mark a CAMERA beat only when the jolt is purely visual.
- At most 6 hook anchors and 6 cliffhanger anchors. Fewer is fine. Spread them over
  different moments of the episode instead of marking neighbouring beats of the same moment.
- device (hooks): one or two words, e.g. slap, reveal, insult, threat, confession, humiliation, collapse.
- open_question (cliffhangers): the question the viewer is left with, in under 15 words.

Return ONLY this JSON:
{"hook_anchors": [{"beat_id": "E01.B012", "hook_intensity": 8, "device": "insult", "excerpt": "verbatim words", "why": "short reason"}],
  "cliffhanger_anchors": [{"beat_id": "E01.B040", "cliffhanger_tension": 7, "open_question": "string", "excerpt": "verbatim words", "why": "short reason"}]}
